mapper.select: select t1.collect_time, t1.cpu_usage, t1.process_cpu_usage, t1.heap_used, t1.heap_max, t1.nonheap_used, t1.threads_live, t1.threads_blocked, t1.gc_count, t1.gc_pause_ms, t1.qps, t1.p95_ms, t1.error_rate, t1.pool_active, t1.pool_pending, t1.pool_max, t1.disk_free from sys_metric_sample t1 where t1.collect_time >= #{start} and t1.collect_time < #{end} order by t1.collect_time
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_metric_rollup (granularity, bucket_time, cpu_usage_avg, process_cpu_usage_avg, heap_used_avg, heap_used_max, heap_max_avg, nonheap_used_avg, threads_live_avg, threads_live_max, gc_count_sum, gc_pause_ms_sum, qps_avg, qps_max, p95_ms_max, error_rate_avg, error_rate_max, pool_active_max, pool_pending_max, pool_max_avg, disk_free_min) select '5m', from_unixtime(floor(unix_timestamp(t1.collect_time) / 300) * 300), round(avg(t1.cpu_usage), 2), round(avg(t1.process_cpu_usage), 2), round(avg(t1.heap_used)), max(t1.heap_used), round(avg(t1.heap_max)), round(avg(t1.nonheap_used)), round(avg(t1.threads_live)), max(t1.threads_live), ifnull(sum(t1.gc_count), 0), ifnull(sum(t1.gc_pause_ms), 0), round(avg(t1.qps), 2), max(t1.qps), max(t1.p95_ms), round(avg(t1.error_rate), 2), max(t1.error_rate), max(t1.pool_active), max(t1.pool_pending), round(avg(t1.pool_max)), min(t1.disk_free) from sys_metric_sample t1 where t1.collect_time >= #{start} and t1.collect_time < #{end}
group by from_unixtime(floor(unix_timestamp(t1.collect_time) / 300) * 300)
